products.name: The drum key
products.blurb: Lives on your keyring instead of at the bottom of the stick bag. Square socket, so it turns any tension rod on any kit you walk up to.
products.spec_note: Keyring loop. Prints in a few hours.
products.alt: Rendering of a T-handled drum key in orange printed plastic, with a keyring hole through the handle and a square socket at the tip.

products.name: Rack ears for the XR18
products.blurb: A pair of brackets that turn a Behringer XR18 into rack gear, so it rides in the case with everything else instead of loose in the back of the van. Uses the mixer's own case screws — nothing to drill.
products.alt: Rendering of a small dark digital mixer with an orange printed rack-mount bracket bolted to each side, each bracket drilled with two holes.

products.name: The stick holder
products.blurb: Clamps to a stand tube and holds a spare pair where your hand already goes. The first run went in a week and there is not a second one yet.
products.spec_head: PETG · fits a standard stand tube
products.alt: Rendering of an orange printed stick holder clamped to a vertical stand tube, with two drumsticks angled out of the open top.
